title: viola orientalis
intro: Viola orientalis, commonly known as the Oriental pansy or Yellow-flowered violet, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Violaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Viola orientalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are also attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antidiabetic properties.
